description: This file defines the RoutePreloader class in Drupal, responsible for preloading non-admin routes to optimize database queries and route handling.

classes.name: RoutePreloader
classes.description: A class that preloads non-admin routes in Drupal to improve performance by reducing database queries during page rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RoutePreloader with route provider and state service dependencies.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Preloads routes if the request format is HTML and the route provider supports preloading.

methods.name: onAlterRoutes
methods.description: Identifies non-admin routes during route build and stores their names.

methods.name: onFinishedRoutes
methods.description: Stores the list of non-admin routes in the state after route building is complete.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers event listeners for route alteration, route finishing, and request events.

methods.name: isGetAndHtmlRoute
methods.description: Checks if a route supports GET method and has an HTML format.
